notes: ONE shared household clock. Not a clock per kid. One alarm and one leaveBy per weekday.
leaveBy is on-the-road time. Downstairs is 15 minutes before that.
Any weekday can be a wake-up morning. The calendar run-days file decides which dates run.
Monday through Thursday: alarm 06:00 / on the road 07:10. Tuesday and Wednesday use those times.
Friday: alarm 06:30 / on the road 07:40 (late start).
Saturday and Sunday stay off. The run-days file sets run = kids_home AND not no_school, from the private calendar (see the run-days routine), so a weekend must not wake the kids.
